text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl runs well in the Oka
Sho. She
displays strength befitting of a
top-class runner
on the track.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! I feel like I ran a million
times better
than I did at the Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mile races and I are a match made in
heaven!
That said...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Should I really give up on the
2,400-meter
Japanese Oaks? I mean,
after that race is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have two choices moving
forward,
correct?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can either run in the NHK Mile
Championship or
the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If 1,600-meter mile races are the best
distance
for her, then she should go for
the G1 NHK Mile
Championship.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was bound to happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if she can handle running 2,400
meters, then she should tackle the
Japanese Oaks and forge
on with the
Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This race made something very clear to
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I really am best suited to running mile
races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That would be the logical conclusion,
but the
decision isn't that easy...
choice_data_list: I see, should we go with the NHK M...
Right, then how about the NHK Mile...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My ultimate goal is to win a European
G1...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And the greatest European G1 is 2,400
meters
long, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without her naming the race, I
know what she's referring to. After all,
everyone in the Umamusume world
dreams of one particular
French G1.
choice_data_list: I see, that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we could go after any G1 race, it
would be that
one. But how far should
our pursuit go?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate glory... The most gorgeous
of all
dreams...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No one is immune to the allure of that
trophy.
And so we racers train day in,
day out...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
With my ability, I might really be able to
get
there one day! Assuming luck is on
my side!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But... I probably shouldn't try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl curbs her enthusiasm
and desire
with amazing self-restraint.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I have plenty of reasons for this
decision.
One of them is because of the
European tracks.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running on that deep turf is really
draining. It's not realistic to expect
someone like me who can
barely run
2,400 meters to do well on it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But the bigger reason is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, our goal isn't to achieve a dream
that
everyone else is already chasing
after.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's more important for me to build
myself up so I
can show the world my
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's a difference between being
courageous
and being reckless, and
what I want to show
everyone is courage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can still aim for the world with sprints
and mile
races. Let's not forget our
original goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her usual spontaneous demeanor,
Seeking the Pearl is actually
very level-headed and considers
everything carefully. This, too, is
another of her strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She knows when to hold back when she
needs to.
If this is what she wants to do,
then there's no
need to agonize over it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay. If you're on the same page as me,
then
there's no problem at all.
choice_data_list: All right! Let's make the NHK Mile...
Then let's make the next goal the ...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing for me to be down
about. There
are plenty of prestigious
G1 mile races in Europe
too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I'm aiming for those,
I can't let myself fall
behind domestically either! After all,
compared to the Oka Sho, the NHK Mile
Championship will have even stronger
racers!
